0.name: The Fool
0.upright: A new chapter is opening. The Fool invites you to take the first step even before the plan is complete, led by curiosity and an open heart, while keeping your common sense with you.
0.reversed: The energy of a fresh start splits two ways: frozen by fear at the edge, or jumping without looking. Ask yourself whether you need more courage right now, or more time to prepare.
0.love: The butterflies stage of something new, or a bright fresh start together. Enjoy it, and notice whether the other person is ready to be serious.
0.career: A green light for a new job, a change of field, or a project you have never tried. Your enthusiasm is your strength right now.
0.money: Money tends to flow toward experiences and new things. Set a budget first, then be brave within limits you can afford.
0.health: Fresh energy and an appetite for a new routine. Starting will feel easy; keeping it going is the part to plan for.

1.name: The Magician
1.upright: You already have what you need to make this happen: the skills, the tools and the timing. The Magician asks you to focus your intention and turn ideas into action.
1.reversed: Your talent is there, but energy may be scattered, or you may doubt yourself. It can also warn of clever words without substance; check what is real before you commit.
1.love: Charm and good communication draw people in. Make sure words and actions match, on both sides.
1.career: A strong time to pitch, present, start a project or show what you can do. Use every resource you have.
1.money: Practical skill can turn into income. Focus on one clear plan rather than many half-started ideas.
1.health: Good energy for taking charge of your routine. Small, deliberate habits will work better than big promises.

2.name: The High Priestess
2.upright: Not everything is visible yet, and that is fine. The High Priestess asks you to slow down, listen to your inner voice and trust what you sense before you act.
2.reversed: You may be ignoring your gut feeling, or something is being kept hidden. Make some quiet time to hear yourself again, and check the facts calmly.
2.love: Deep feelings that haven't been fully spoken yet. Give the connection time, and pay attention to what you sense rather than only what is said.
2.career: Observe before you act. Information still to come will matter, so keep your plans flexible.
2.money: A time to review quietly rather than make big moves. Trust careful research over tips from others.
2.health: Your body is giving signals; rest and quiet help you hear them. If something feels off, check with a professional.

3.name: The Empress
3.upright: Something is growing and ready to flourish. The Empress brings warmth, care, comfort and creativity, and reminds you to nurture yourself as well as others.
3.reversed: You may be giving so much that nothing is left for you, or growth has slowed. Fill your own cup first, and let things grow at their natural pace.
3.love: A warm, caring and affectionate time. Love grows through attention, comfort and quality time together.
3.career: Creative work and projects you have nurtured start to bear fruit. A good time for design, care-based work or anything you make with your hands.
3.money: Comfort and steady growth. Enjoy what you have, while keeping spending in line with what truly brings you joy.
3.health: Nourishing food, rest, nature and gentle movement restore you. Treat your body with kindness.

4.name: The Emperor
4.upright: It's time to bring order and structure. The Emperor asks you to set clear goals, make plans and lead with steady, responsible authority.
4.reversed: Structure may have tipped into control or stubbornness, or there is a struggle with someone in charge. Ask whether the rules still serve you, and lead with fairness.
4.love: A stable, protective and committed partner or phase. Make sure stability doesn't become one person controlling the other.
4.career: Leadership, clear systems and long-term planning bring results. Working with authority figures goes well when you are prepared.
4.money: Budgets, plans and discipline build security. A good time to organise finances properly.
4.health: Regular routines, sleep and structure support your energy. Avoid pushing through on willpower alone.

5.name: The Hierophant
5.upright: Wisdom comes through teachers, traditions and proven ways of doing things. The Hierophant points to learning, mentors, ceremonies and commitments made in good faith.
5.reversed: You may be questioning the rules you grew up with, or feeling restricted by them. Keep what still rings true, and find your own path where it doesn't.
5.love: Commitment, shared values and traditional steps such as meeting family or making things official.
5.career: Training, mentors, institutions and proper procedures. Learning from someone experienced helps a lot.
5.money: Stick to conventional, well-tested approaches and get advice from qualified people.
5.health: Established routines and qualified advice work best. A good time for steady, proven habits.

6.name: The Lovers
6.upright: A meaningful connection or an important choice of the heart. The Lovers asks you to choose what truly matches your values, in love or in life.
6.reversed: Something feels out of tune: values that don't match, mixed feelings, or a decision being put off. Be honest about what you really want.
6.love: Strong attraction, deep connection and mutual choice. A relationship where both people choose each other.
6.career: A choice between paths, or a partnership at work. Choose the option that matches your values, not only the easier one.
6.money: Decide according to your priorities. Shared finances work best when both people agree openly.
6.health: Balance between head and heart. Do what feels right for your body, not what others expect.

7.name: The Chariot
7.upright: Forward movement through focus and determination. The Chariot says you can win this by steering your energy firmly toward one clear goal.
7.reversed: You may be pulled in different directions, or pushing so hard that you lose control. Slow down, pick one direction and steer again.
7.love: Moving the relationship forward with intention. Work as a team toward the same destination.
7.career: Strong progress, ambition and wins through effort. A good time for goals, competitions and work travel.
7.money: Discipline and a clear target bring results. Stay in control of spending while you chase the goal.
7.health: Strong drive and energy. Channel it into steady effort rather than pushing past your limits.

8.name: Strength
8.upright: Real strength is quiet. This card shows courage, patience and a calm heart that can handle strong feelings or difficult situations with kindness rather than force.
8.reversed: You may be doubting yourself, feeling drained, or reacting too quickly. Be gentle with yourself; your strength is still there, it just needs rest.
8.love: Patience, tenderness and emotional maturity make the bond stronger. Gentle honesty works better than pressure.
8.career: Steady confidence and calm handling of difficult people or tasks will earn respect.
8.money: Self-control and patience pay off. Resist impulse decisions and stay on your plan.
8.health: Resilience and good stamina. Look after your energy with kindness rather than pushing through.

9.name: The Hermit
9.upright: A time to step back and look inward. The Hermit invites quiet reflection, some time alone and listening to your own wisdom before taking the next step.
9.reversed: Time alone may have turned into isolation or loneliness. It may be time to reconnect with people you trust, or to stop avoiding something.
9.love: Needing space to understand your own feelings. Singles may prefer their own company for now; couples benefit from honest, quiet talks.
9.career: Deep, focused work, research or rethinking your direction. Good advice may come from a mentor.
9.money: Careful, thoughtful decisions. Take time to review before committing.
9.health: Rest, quiet and time in nature recharge you. Balance solitude with some connection.

10.name: Wheel of Fortune
10.upright: Life is turning. The Wheel of Fortune brings change, a new cycle and often a lucky break. Stay flexible and make the most of the opportunities that come round.
10.reversed: The wheel is turning in a way you didn't want, or you are resisting change. This phase will pass; focus on what you can control.
10.love: A turning point: a surprise meeting, a new stage, or a change in the relationship's rhythm.
10.career: Unexpected opportunities and shifts. Be ready to move when the timing is right.
10.money: Ups and downs. Make use of good periods and keep a cushion for slower ones.
10.health: Energy moves in cycles. Adjust your routine to the season you are in.

11.name: Justice
11.upright: What is fair and true will come to light. Justice asks you to be honest, weigh things carefully and take responsibility for your choices. Agreements, contracts and decisions go well when they are fair.
11.reversed: Something feels unfair, or someone is avoiding responsibility. Look at the facts honestly, including your own part, and correct what you can.
11.love: Balance, honesty and fairness in the relationship. Talk openly about what each person gives and needs.
11.career: Contracts, agreements and fair decisions. Be thorough and transparent.
11.money: Check the details, read the fine print and keep things balanced. Settle what is owed.
11.health: Balance in daily habits. Look honestly at what your body needs.

12.name: The Hanged Man
12.upright: Things are on hold for a reason. The Hanged Man invites you to pause, let go of forcing and look at the situation from a completely different angle.
12.reversed: You may feel stuck, or keep putting off a decision. Ask whether the waiting still has a purpose, or whether it's time to let go and move.
12.love: A pause in the relationship, or seeing your partner in a new light. Don't force answers right now.
12.career: Delays or waiting for a decision. Use this time to rethink your approach.
12.money: Not the time for big moves. Wait, review and see what changes.
12.health: Rest and slowing down help more than pushing. A change of routine may bring a fresh outlook.

13.name: Death
13.upright: This card almost never means physical death. It marks the end of a chapter whose time is over, making room for something new. Letting go now makes the transition easier.
13.reversed: You may be holding on to something that has already ended. The change is waiting for you to release it.
13.love: A relationship transforms or a phase ends, making space for something healthier, together or apart.
13.career: An old role, project or way of working comes to an end, opening a new direction.
13.money: Clear out what no longer works, such as old habits or subscriptions, and restructure.
13.health: A good time to let go of old habits and start fresh routines.

14.name: Temperance
14.upright: Finding the middle path. Temperance brings balance, patience and healing by blending different parts of life in the right amounts.
14.reversed: Something is out of balance: too much of one thing, too little of another, or rushing. Come back to the middle and slow the pace.
14.love: A calm, balanced relationship built on compromise and patience. Healing after a difficult time.
14.career: Cooperation and steady pacing. Combine different skills or people to get the best result.
14.money: Moderation and steady saving. Avoid extremes in spending.
14.health: Balance and moderation in food, sleep and activity support healing.

15.name: The Devil
15.upright: Something has a hold on you: a habit, a desire, a fear or an unhealthy pattern. The chains in this card are loose; seeing them clearly is the first step to freedom.
15.reversed: You are starting to see the pattern and break free. Keep going, one step at a time, and ask for support if you need it.
15.love: Strong attraction, or a relationship that feels hard to leave. Ask whether it is love, or attachment and habit.
15.career: Feeling stuck in a job for money or security, or caught in office politics. Look for your real options.
15.money: Watch impulse spending, debt or get-rich-quick offers. Take back control step by step.
15.health: Look honestly at habits that drain you. Support from others or a professional can help you change them.

16.name: The Tower
16.upright: Something built on shaky ground is falling away, often suddenly. It can feel shocking, but the truth that comes out clears space to rebuild on something stronger.
16.reversed: Change you have been avoiding is still waiting, or you are dealing with the aftermath. Face it step by step rather than holding the cracks together.
16.love: A sudden truth or change shakes the relationship. What is real will remain, and what isn't will fall away.
16.career: Unexpected changes at work. Stay flexible; this can open a better path.
16.money: An unexpected expense or change. Keep a safety cushion and avoid risky moves.
16.health: Stress may build up suddenly; slow down and make time to recover. See a professional if something worries you.

17.name: The Star
17.upright: After a difficult time, hope returns. The Star brings healing, calm and renewed faith that things can get better. Let yourself believe in the future again.
17.reversed: You may feel discouraged or disconnected from hope. Small acts of self-care and talking to people you trust can bring the light back.
17.love: Healing, openness and gentle hope in love. A sincere connection that feels refreshing.
17.career: Inspiration and a sense of purpose return. A good time to share your ideas and goals.
17.money: Slow, steady recovery. Keep faith in your plan.
17.health: A healing and restoring period. Rest, water and calm help you recover.

18.name: The Moon
18.upright: Things are unclear right now, and fear or imagination may fill the gaps. The Moon asks you to move slowly, trust your intuition and check facts before you believe the worst.
18.reversed: The fog is lifting. Confusion clears, fears lose their power and the truth becomes easier to see.
18.love: Mixed signals or uncertainty. Don't jump to conclusions; give it time and talk openly.
18.career: Unclear information or plans. Ask questions and get details in writing.
18.money: Not a time for decisions based on rumours or unclear offers. Check everything carefully.
18.health: Restless sleep or worry may affect your energy. Calm routines help; see a professional if worries persist.

19.name: The Sun
19.upright: One of the brightest cards in the deck. The Sun brings joy, success, warmth and clarity. Things become clear, and you can shine as yourself.
19.reversed: The sun is still there, just behind a cloud. Success may be delayed or confidence may dip, but the overall outlook is good.
19.love: Happiness, warmth and openness. A joyful, honest relationship you are proud of.
19.career: Success, recognition and clear progress. Your work is seen and appreciated.
19.money: A positive, abundant period. Enjoy it and share the good fortune wisely.
19.health: Vitality and good energy. Sunshine, play and time outdoors lift you up.

20.name: Judgement
20.upright: A wake-up call. Judgement asks you to look back honestly, learn from the past and answer a calling toward a new version of yourself.
20.reversed: You may be judging yourself too harshly, or ignoring a call to change. Forgive yourself and listen to what you already know.
20.love: A second chance, an honest talk about the past, or a clear decision about the future of the relationship.
20.career: A calling to a new direction, or an important evaluation. Trust what you have learned.
20.money: Review your finances honestly and settle old matters.
20.health: A good time for a fresh start with healthier habits, based on what you have learned.

21.name: The World
21.upright: A cycle comes to a successful end. The World brings completion, fulfilment and the feeling that everything has come together. Celebrate, then get ready for the next adventure.
21.reversed: You are close to the finish line, but something is still unfinished. Tie up loose ends before moving on.
21.love: A fulfilling, complete relationship, or reaching an important milestone together.
21.career: Finishing a big project, reaching a goal, or work that connects you with the wider world.
21.money: Goals reached and stability achieved. A good moment to review and plan the next stage.
21.health: Feeling whole and balanced. Celebrate the progress you have made.

22.name: Ace of Wands
22.upright: A spark of inspiration arrives. The Ace of Wands brings fresh energy, excitement and the push to start something new. Act while the fire is strong.
22.reversed: The spark is there but blocked, or energy fizzles before anything is built. Start with one small step instead of waiting for the perfect moment.
22.love: New attraction, chemistry and excitement, or a spark returning to an existing relationship.
22.career: A new project, idea or venture. A good time to take initiative.
22.money: A new income idea or opportunity that grows if you act on it.
22.health: Rising energy and motivation to get moving. Build the routine so it lasts.

23.name: Two of Wands
23.upright: You have a solid base and you're looking at a bigger world. The Two of Wands is about planning your next move and choosing which direction to grow in.
23.reversed: Fear of leaving your comfort zone keeps you in place, or you're rushing ahead without a plan. Make the plan, then make the choice.
23.love: Thinking about the future together. Do your long-term plans point the same way?
23.career: Planning a bigger step, expansion or relocation. Weigh the options, then commit.
23.money: Weigh security against growth and plan for the long term.
23.health: Set a clear intention and make a realistic plan for your routine.

24.name: Three of Wands
24.upright: Your plans are in motion and the horizon is opening up. The Three of Wands brings progress, growth and opportunities that may come from far away.
24.reversed: Results are slower or smaller than expected. Be patient, adjust the plan and strengthen your groundwork.
24.love: Moving forward together, long-distance love, or looking beyond your usual type.
24.career: Expansion, trade, travel or international work. Things you started are beginning to pay off.
24.money: Investments in your future start to grow. Patience brings returns.
24.health: Earlier efforts start to show. Keep going consistently.

25.name: Four of Wands
25.upright: A milestone worth celebrating. The Four of Wands brings joy, homecoming, stability and happy gatherings with the people you love.
25.reversed: Celebrations may be delayed, or harmony at home or in a group feels shaky. Sort out the foundation before the party.
25.love: A happy, secure time: moving in, engagement, a wedding or meeting the family.
25.career: A project completed, a successful launch or a supportive team.
25.money: Hard work paying off, with room to enjoy some of it.
25.health: Rest and feeling at home in yourself again.

26.name: Five of Wands
26.upright: Lots of competing voices and energy. The Five of Wands shows friction, rivalry or debate. It can sharpen you, as long as everyone plays fair.
26.reversed: Conflict is being avoided or kept under the surface, or things are finally calming down. Say what needs to be said, kindly.
26.love: Bickering, playful sparring or competition for attention. Clear the air honestly.
26.career: Competition, clashing opinions or a busy team phase. Stay focused on the real goal.
26.money: Competing priorities for your money. Decide what matters most.
26.health: Restless energy that needs an outlet, such as exercise or sport.

27.name: Six of Wands
27.upright: A win that others can see. The Six of Wands brings success, recognition and well-earned confidence. Enjoy the moment and let yourself be seen.
27.reversed: Recognition is delayed, or success feels empty. Look for your own measure of success rather than waiting for applause.
27.love: A proud, supportive relationship where you feel chosen and celebrated.
27.career: Promotion, praise, a won pitch or stepping into leadership.
27.money: Rewards for your competence and a sense of progress.
27.health: Recovery and returning confidence in your body.

28.name: Seven of Wands
28.upright: You're holding your position against pressure. The Seven of Wands asks for courage and firm boundaries. What you've built is worth defending.
28.reversed: You may be worn down and ready to give up, or fighting more battles than you need to. Choose what's worth defending and accept help.
28.love: Protecting the relationship from outside pressure, or being defensive after past hurt.
28.career: Defending your ideas, role or rates. Don't try to carry everything alone.
28.money: Hold firm on your budget and limits.
28.health: Strong stamina, but constant tension needs release.

29.name: Eight of Wands
29.upright: Things are moving fast. The Eight of Wands brings quick progress, messages, news and travel. Act while the momentum is here.
29.reversed: Delays, crossed wires or waiting on others. Slow down, check details and clear what's blocking the way.
29.love: Fast-moving connection, lots of messages, or renewed excitement.
29.career: Quick offers, decisions and focused productivity. Work travel is possible.
29.health: A quick return of energy and motivation.

30.name: Nine of Wands
30.upright: Tired but still standing. The Nine of Wands says you are close to the finish line. Hold on a little longer, protect your energy and keep healthy boundaries.
30.reversed: Exhaustion or old hurts make you overly guarded. Rest, lower your defences where it's safe and accept support.
30.love: A bond worn by past difficulties that needs honest talk. Singles may be cautious about opening up.
30.career: A draining stretch that is nearly over. Keep going, but don't burn out.
30.money: Protect your savings and rebuild slowly.
30.health: You are running on reserves; rest is as important as effort.

31.name: Ten of Wands
31.upright: You're carrying too much. The Ten of Wands shows heavy responsibility near the end of a long effort. Sort out what is truly yours to carry.
31.reversed: Relief comes when you put some of the load down, or things give way because you held on too long. Delegate and ask for help.
31.love: One person carrying most of the load. Share responsibilities more fairly.
31.career: Too many tasks and duties. Prioritise and delegate.
31.money: Several obligations at once. Deal with them step by step.
31.health: Long-term overload; your body is asking for rest.

32.name: Page of Wands
32.upright: A curious, adventurous spirit. The Page of Wands brings exciting news, new interests and the urge to explore. Try it and learn as you go.
32.reversed: Lots of excitement but little follow-through. Pick one idea and stick with it.
32.love: Playful flirting and fun early attraction.
32.career: A green light to try a new idea or learn something new.
32.money: Test new ideas on a small scale first.
32.health: Excitement for a new activity; pace yourself.

33.name: Knight of Wands
33.upright: Bold, fast and full of energy. The Knight of Wands charges toward adventure and new goals. Go for it, but know where you're heading.
33.reversed: Rushing, impatience or quick temper leads to unfinished plans. Slow down enough to aim.
33.love: Intense, exciting attraction that moves fast; check whether it has staying power.
33.career: Rapid progress, travel or a bold move. Energy is high.
33.money: Bold moves are possible, but avoid impulse spending.
33.health: High energy; keep it steady instead of burning out.

34.name: Queen of Wands
34.upright: Warm, confident and magnetic. The Queen of Wands invites you to step into the light, be yourself fully and lead with warmth and courage.
34.reversed: Insecurity, jealousy or exhaustion dims your light. Reconnect with what makes you shine.
34.love: Warm, passionate and self-assured love. Being fully yourself is your attraction.
34.career: A respected, energetic leader who inspires others.
34.money: Confident, decisive action once you've done the research.

35.name: King of Wands
35.upright: A natural leader with vision. The King of Wands turns big ideas into reality, inspires others and takes bold, well-directed action.
35.reversed: Leadership may tip into control or impatience. Listen to others and share the work.
35.love: A passionate, loyal and protective partner who wants an equal.
35.career: Leadership, founding something or taking charge of a big project.
35.health: Strong energy; watch stress and remember to delegate.

36.name: Ace of Cups
36.upright: Your heart is filling up. The Ace of Cups brings new love, emotional renewal, compassion and the chance to receive something good. Open up and let it in.
36.reversed: Feelings may be blocked, or you're giving more than you receive. Fill your own cup first and be gentle with yourself.
36.love: A new relationship or feelings blossoming. Love given and received freely.
36.career: Work that touches your heart, or caring and creative projects.
36.money: Choices guided by your values and what truly matters to you.

37.name: Two of Cups
37.upright: Two people meeting as equals. The Two of Cups brings mutual attraction, partnership and a bond where both sides give and receive.
37.reversed: The balance is off: one side gives more, or communication has broken down. Talk openly about what each of you needs.
37.love: A balanced, loving connection, a new romance, or making up after a disagreement.
37.career: A strong partnership or collaboration built on trust.
37.money: Pooling resources with someone you trust, on fair terms.
37.health: Support from someone close helps you feel better.

38.name: Three of Cups
38.upright: A time of shared happiness. The Three of Cups brings celebrations, reunions with friends and success that others share with you. Joy grows when it's shared.
38.reversed: The circle feels shaky: gossip, jealousy or too much partying. Spend time with the people who genuinely support you.
38.love: Fun and warmth. Early dating may be light; couples enjoy time with friends and family.
38.career: Teamwork, networking and celebrating group success.
38.money: Shared projects and fair sharing of rewards. Watch social spending.
38.health: Support from good company. Avoid overdoing food, drink or late nights.

39.name: Four of Cups
39.upright: Life feels flat and nothing excites you. The Four of Cups suggests you may be so focused on what's missing that you don't notice a new offer right in front of you.
39.reversed: The fog is lifting and interest returns. You're ready to say yes again, or to say a clear, mindful no.
39.love: Boredom or taking each other for granted. Look again at what is being offered.
39.career: Feeling bored at work or overlooking an opportunity.
39.money: Opportunities may drift past; pay attention.
39.health: Emotional tiredness; real rest and small joys help.

40.name: Five of Cups
40.upright: Something has been lost and it hurts. The Five of Cups honours that grief, and gently points out that two cups are still standing behind you: what remains still matters.
40.reversed: The worst is passing. You're beginning to accept the loss, forgive and move on.
40.love: Disappointment or grieving a relationship. Healing comes when you look at what is still there.
40.career: A setback, while your skills and contacts are still intact.
40.money: A loss that stings, but you still have something to rebuild with.
40.health: Feeling low and heavy; let feelings move and lean on support.

41.name: Six of Cups
41.upright: Sweet memories and simple kindness. The Six of Cups brings nostalgia, reunions with people from your past and gestures of goodwill.
41.reversed: Living too much in the past, or idealising how things used to be. Take the good lessons and bring them into the present.
41.love: An old flame, a familiar connection, or rediscovering playfulness together.
41.career: A past contact or old passion comes back.

42.name: Seven of Cups
42.upright: Many options and big dreams, but not all of them are real. The Seven of Cups asks you to look closely at each choice before you commit.
42.reversed: Clarity returns. Illusions fall away and you can focus on one real choice.
42.love: Idealising someone or missing warning signs. See the person as they are.
42.career: Too many ideas at once; pick one path.
42.money: Be careful with offers that sound too good to be true.
42.health: Mental fog or daydreaming; grounding routines help.

43.name: Eight of Cups
43.upright: Leaving something that no longer fulfils you. The Eight of Cups shows the courage to walk away from what looks fine on the outside, in search of something more meaningful.
43.reversed: You may be staying because you're afraid of change, or leaving to avoid facing something. Be honest about your reasons.
43.love: A relationship that feels empty, or searching for deeper connection.
43.career: Leaving a stable but draining job, or looking for more meaningful work.
43.money: Letting go of something that only looks secure.
43.health: Letting go of habits that no longer serve you.

44.name: Nine of Cups
44.upright: Known as the wish card. The Nine of Cups brings satisfaction, comfort and getting what you hoped for. Enjoy it and feel grateful.
44.reversed: Success that feels empty, or trying to fill a gap with too much comfort. Ask what would truly satisfy you.
44.love: Happiness and self-love; feeling good on your own and together.
44.career: A goal achieved; take time to enjoy it.
44.money: Comfort and enjoyment, with room for a treat.
44.health: Feeling good; enjoy pleasures in moderation.

45.name: Ten of Cups
45.upright: Lasting happiness and a sense of belonging. The Ten of Cups brings harmony at home, loving relationships and emotional fulfilment.
45.reversed: Tension behind a happy picture, or expecting a perfect family. Real harmony comes from honest conversations.
45.love: A mature, committed relationship and building a home together.
45.money: Security for the people you love.
45.health: Wellbeing that comes from good relationships.

46.name: Page of Cups
46.upright: A gentle new feeling or a sweet surprise. The Page of Cups brings emotional messages, creative ideas and a playful, open heart.
46.reversed: Moodiness, mixed signals or a creative block. Express feelings honestly and stay grounded.
46.love: A crush, an admirer, or renewed playfulness in a relationship.
46.career: A creative start; follow what genuinely interests you.
46.money: Hopeful ideas that still need practical action.
46.health: Be kind to yourself and honour your feelings.

47.name: Knight of Cups
47.upright: Following your heart. The Knight of Cups arrives with an offer, an invitation or a romantic gesture. Act from the heart and keep your promises.
47.reversed: Promises without follow-through, or expectations that are too idealistic. Check that words and actions match.
47.love: A romantic offer, a suitor or a heartfelt gesture.
47.career: Creative or meaningful work, or an attractive offer.
47.money: A heart-led idea that needs a practical plan.
47.health: Creative outlets and gentle care support your wellbeing.

48.name: Queen of Cups
48.upright: Deep empathy and a calm heart. The Queen of Cups listens, cares and trusts her intuition, while staying emotionally steady.
48.reversed: Carrying everyone's feelings until you're drained. Protect your energy and care for yourself too.
48.career: Caring or creative roles, such as counselling, art or mediation.
48.money: Decisions guided by intuition and stability.
48.health: Honour your feelings and stay centred.

49.name: King of Cups
49.upright: Calm on stormy water. The King of Cups feels deeply but stays composed, offering wise, steady support and diplomacy.
49.reversed: Feelings may be bottled up or used to steer others. Acknowledge emotions honestly.
49.love: A stable, caring and emotionally mature partner.
49.career: Diplomatic leadership, mediation or counselling roles.
49.health: Steady emotions; work through feelings calmly.

50.name: Ace of Swords
50.upright: A moment of clear thinking. The Ace of Swords cuts through confusion and brings truth, a fresh idea or a decision you can stand behind.
50.reversed: Confusion, mixed messages or decisions based on wrong information. Check the facts and speak with care.
50.love: An honest conversation that clears the air.
50.career: A strong idea or clear strategy. Communicate it directly.
50.money: A realistic look at the numbers.
50.health: Clear thinking about your needs; get facts from a professional.

51.name: Two of Swords
51.upright: Stuck between two options and not wanting to look. The Two of Swords asks you to remove the blindfold, gather information and make the choice.
51.reversed: The standoff breaks. Hidden information comes out and a decision can't be delayed any longer.
51.love: Avoiding a conversation or a decision about the relationship.
51.career: Waiting on others or torn between options.
51.money: Avoiding the numbers; face them calmly.
51.health: Tension from holding feelings in; find an honest outlet.

52.name: Three of Swords
52.upright: A painful truth or heartbreak. The Three of Swords honours the hurt and reminds you that letting yourself feel it is how healing begins.
52.reversed: Healing has started and the pain is easing. Forgive when you're ready and stop reopening the wound.
52.love: Heartbreak, a painful truth or a difficult ending.
52.money: An unwelcome cost; face the real figures.
52.health: Stress weighing on you; rest and lean on support.

53.name: Four of Swords
53.upright: Time to rest and recover. The Four of Swords asks you to step back, quiet your mind and recharge before the next step.
53.reversed: Refusing to rest, or slowly getting back to action after a break. Listen to what your body and mind need.
53.love: Quiet time together, or taking time to heal before dating.
53.money: Hold off on big decisions and review your budget.

54.name: Five of Swords
54.upright: A win that costs too much. The Five of Swords warns that winning the argument can mean losing the relationship. Choose your battles.
54.reversed: A chance to make peace, apologise or walk away from a pointless fight.
54.love: Hurtful words or a power struggle; an apology may be needed.
54.money: Disputes; weigh whether the fight is worth it.

55.name: Six of Swords
55.upright: Leaving a hard time behind. The Six of Swords shows a gradual move toward calmer, better circumstances, even if it feels bittersweet.
55.reversed: The move is delayed, or old problems are following you. Deal with what you're carrying.
55.love: Leaving a difficult period behind, together or apart.
55.career: Leaving a stressful role, or relocating.

56.name: Seven of Swords
56.upright: Acting quietly or strategically. The Seven of Swords asks you to think carefully, protect what matters and be honest with yourself about your motives.
56.reversed: Secrets come out, or it's time to come clean. Honesty brings relief.
56.love: Someone guarding their feelings. Take things slowly and keep communication honest. This card is not proof that anyone is cheating.
56.career: Be strategic, and protect your work and ideas.
56.money: Read the fine print and watch for hidden costs.
56.health: Something may have been overlooked; a second opinion can help.

57.name: Eight of Swords
57.upright: Feeling stuck with no way out. The Eight of Swords shows that the trap is often held together by fear and beliefs; the way out is closer than it seems.
57.reversed: The blindfold slips and you see your options. You're starting to free yourself.
57.love: Feeling stuck in a pattern, or unable to stop thinking about someone.
57.career: Feeling locked into a role, or doubting your abilities.
57.money: Fears feel bigger than the real numbers.
57.health: Overthinking; one small step can break the loop.

58.name: Nine of Swords
58.upright: Worries that feel loudest at night. The Nine of Swords shows anxious thoughts that often seem bigger in the dark. Talking about them usually makes them lighter.
58.reversed: Worries begin to ease as you face them or share them with someone you trust.
58.love: Worry about the relationship or fear of being left.
58.money: Fear may be larger than the real situation; look at the facts.
58.health: Worry affecting your rest. Talk to someone you trust or a professional.

59.name: Ten of Swords
59.upright: A hard chapter has ended, and the worst is behind you. The Ten of Swords shows rock bottom, with dawn already on the horizon: from here, things can only get better.
59.reversed: Recovery has begun. Healing takes time, so be patient with yourself.
59.love: A painful ending, or a pattern that has run its course.
59.money: The low point has been reached; stop the losses and start again.
59.health: Deep tiredness; rest and support come first.

60.name: Page of Swords
60.upright: A sharp, curious mind. The Page of Swords asks questions, gathers information and brings news or a fresh perspective.
60.reversed: Gossip, overthinking or speaking before thinking. Check your sources.
60.love: Lively conversations and a meeting of minds.
60.career: A learning phase; ask good questions.
60.money: Read the fine print and stay informed.
60.health: A clear mind; quiet the mental chatter.

61.name: Knight of Swords
61.upright: Charging ahead with clear purpose. The Knight of Swords brings fast action, direct communication and determination.
61.reversed: Rushing, harsh words or impulsive decisions. Aim before you act.
61.love: Direct, honest communication; say clearly what you want.
61.money: Bold moves, once the logic checks out.
61.health: High energy; channel it into exercise.

62.name: Queen of Swords
62.upright: Clear-eyed and honest. The Queen of Swords sees things as they are, speaks truthfully and keeps healthy boundaries, with wisdom earned from experience.
62.reversed: Honesty may turn harsh, or boundaries become walls. Balance truth with kindness.
62.love: Knowing what you want and saying it honestly.
62.career: Precise, strategic work such as editing, law or research.
62.money: Get agreements in writing; don't give in to pressure.
62.health: An active mind; balance discipline with rest.

63.name: King of Swords
63.upright: Clear thinking and fair authority. The King of Swords makes decisions based on facts and principles, and leads with integrity.
63.reversed: Logic without heart, rigid rules or misuse of power. Stay fair and open to other views.
63.health: Follow expert advice and keep clear routines.

64.name: Ace of Pentacles
64.upright: A real, practical opportunity is offered to you. The Ace of Pentacles is a seed for something solid, such as a new job, income or project. Plant it and tend it.
64.reversed: An opportunity is delayed or wasted. Strengthen your foundation and plan before investing.
64.love: A grounded, practical and stable relationship.
64.career: A job offer, promotion or new source of income.
64.money: New money, savings or a safety fund.
64.health: New energy and a steady routine.

65.name: Two of Pentacles
65.upright: Keeping several things in the air. The Two of Pentacles is about staying flexible, balancing priorities and adapting as life keeps moving.
65.reversed: Too much on your plate and something is slipping. Cut back and set clear priorities.
65.love: Balancing the relationship with busy schedules. Make time for each other.
65.career: Multiple roles or tasks; prioritise wisely.
65.money: Money coming in and going out; manage carefully.
65.health: Balancing your needs with everything else; protect your sleep.

66.name: Three of Pentacles
66.upright: Building something together. The Three of Pentacles brings teamwork, skill and recognition for good work.
66.reversed: Poor coordination, clashing egos or work that isn't up to standard. Realign the team and the goals.
66.love: A relationship built on shared effort and daily teamwork.
66.career: Collaboration, being recognised for your skills and staying open to feedback.
66.health: Steady progress with help from professionals.

67.name: Four of Pentacles
67.upright: Holding on to what you have. The Four of Pentacles brings security and careful saving, but warns not to grip so tightly that nothing can move.
67.reversed: Loosening your grip, for better or worse. Share and spend wisely, without swinging to the other extreme.
67.love: Feeling safe, or holding your heart too tightly. Possessiveness can block closeness.
67.career: A secure job, sometimes kept out of fear rather than choice.
67.money: Saving and protecting resources; prudent, but don't become too tight.
67.health: Tension held in the body; learn to let go and relax.

68.name: Five of Pentacles
68.upright: A hard time, often with money, work or security. The Five of Pentacles also shows a lit window nearby: help is closer than you think, so don't be afraid to ask.
68.reversed: Things are starting to improve. Support arrives and the hardest part is easing.
68.love: Feeling unsupported or going through a tough time together. Lean on each other.
68.career: A lean period or setback; look for support and new options.
68.money: Money worries. Ask for practical help and deal with problems step by step.
68.health: Feeling worn down; reach out for support and care.

69.name: Six of Pentacles
69.upright: Giving and receiving in balance. The Six of Pentacles brings generosity, fair exchange and support when it's needed.
69.reversed: Help with strings attached, or one side always giving. Rebalance the exchange.
69.career: A mentor or sponsor, fair pay or a fair agreement.
69.money: Money flowing well, debts repaid, or helping someone in need.
69.health: Care flowing both ways; let yourself accept help.

70.name: Seven of Pentacles
70.upright: Pausing to check how things are growing. The Seven of Pentacles asks you to review your efforts, adjust if needed and trust slow, steady growth.
70.reversed: Frustration with slow results, or effort going into the wrong place. Redirect your energy.
70.love: Taking an honest look at where the relationship is heading.
70.career: Long-term commitment; results come with time.
70.money: Patient, long-term growth rather than quick returns.

71.name: Eight of Pentacles
71.upright: Steady, focused work. The Eight of Pentacles is about practising, improving your skills and taking pride in doing things well.
71.reversed: Perfectionism, boredom or rushing the job. Reconnect with why the work matters.
71.love: Consistent effort and care build trust.
71.career: Training, skill-building and quality work that builds your reputation.
71.money: Steady savings and investing in your skills.
71.health: Routine and tracking progress pay off.

72.name: Nine of Pentacles
72.upright: Enjoying what you've built. The Nine of Pentacles brings independence, comfort and the rewards of your own hard work.
72.reversed: Overworking or spending to prove your worth. Build security from the inside.
72.love: Feeling complete on your own, and choosing relationships that add to your life.
72.career: Thriving work, a profitable side project or a good reputation.
72.money: Self-made security and quality over show.
72.health: Feeling well; keep your good routines.

73.name: Ten of Pentacles
73.upright: Lasting security and legacy. The Ten of Pentacles brings family support, long-term stability and things built to last.
73.reversed: Family tensions around money or property, or what seemed secure starts to shake. Talk openly and review long-term plans.
73.love: A committed relationship focused on building a stable future.
73.career: Established organisations, family business or long-term success.
73.money: Long-term assets, savings and careful management.
73.health: Stable wellbeing; notice family habits and patterns.

74.name: Page of Pentacles
74.upright: An eager, practical learner. The Page of Pentacles brings a new skill, a study opportunity or a first step toward a real goal.
74.reversed: Procrastination or distraction. Stop overthinking and take the first concrete step.
74.career: Courses, internships or good news about work.
74.money: Starting to save and building carefully.
74.health: A fresh start with realistic routines.

75.name: Knight of Pentacles
75.upright: Slow, steady and reliable. The Knight of Pentacles gets results through consistent effort, patience and doing things properly.
75.reversed: Stuck in a rut or stubborn about change. Add some purpose to the routine.
75.love: A loyal, steady partner and a relationship that builds slowly.
75.career: Recognition earned through consistent, quality work.
75.money: Careful planning and avoiding risky bets.

76.name: Queen of Pentacles
76.upright: Care shown through practical things. The Queen of Pentacles creates comfort, security and a well-run home, and looks after people and resources wisely.
76.reversed: Caring for everyone except yourself, or worry about resources. Share the load and rest.
76.love: A warm, steady and practical relationship.
76.career: Steady work; roles in care, teaching or management.

77.name: King of Pentacles
77.upright: Success through steady effort. The King of Pentacles builds lasting value, manages resources wisely and provides security for others.
77.reversed: Too focused on money or status, or controlling resources too tightly. Value people as much as results.
77.love: A loyal, reliable partner who shows love through action.
77.career: Senior leadership, business success or long-term contracts.
77.health: Disciplined routines; don't let work take over.
